title: pm-eng 1:1 prep - Ethan Park & Maya Dawson
body:
Context: Prep notes for weekly PM<>Eng Lead 1:1. Main topics: API stability and rollout, Console canary & UX, Dedicated autoscaling policy, Private deployment packaging (v0.9), and customer escalations.

Agenda:
- Quick wins / highlights (2-3 min)
- API: perf, errors, and rollout plan (10 min)
- Console: canary results & UX feedback (10 min)
- Dedicated: autoscaler tuning and capacity planning (8 min)
- Private: packaging + install tests for v0.9 (8 min)
- Blockers / escalations (5 min)
- Action items & follow-ups (2-3 min)

Updates / notes to bring up:
1) API (Hosted)
- Traffic: steady growth +10% WoW for text-generation endpoints; embeddings flat.
- Recent incident: 2026-03-01 spike in 503s (~30m) during large burst from internal integration test. Root cause looks like transient connection exhaustion in proxy pool.
  - Mitigation applied: increased proxy pool size + rolling restart; metrics improving but still watching.
- Perf: 95th latency for short prompts (<=64 tokens) at ~180ms on prod; target is 150ms. Need to determine if regression tied to kernel selection rollout v2.1.
- Risk: kernel selection rollout could be increasing tail latency. Consider quick rollback throttle for canary traffic to contain impact.

2) Console (Rollouts & UX)
- Canary cohort (~10% orgs) on console v1.4 with new route-level dashboards. Early feedback: useful, but some customers confused by cost attribution UI (token vs request).
- Telemetry: dashboard load times slightly higher (avg +200ms) correlated with new per-route aggregation queries. Might need indexing or a caching tier.
- Plan: hold full rollout until cost-UI copy validated and dashboard latency reduced.

3) Dedicated (Reserved Capacity)
- Autoscaler: current policy underestimates burst headroom — we observed queuing on one Dedicated pool last Friday.
- Proposal: change autoscale targets to maintain 20% spare GPU headroom + faster scale-up (5m -> 90s) for burst windows. Need SRE sign-off and cost tradeoff assessment.
- Capacity: Q2 committed capacity forecast within +/-10% of current pools but two enterprise deals could add 2 clusters by May; plan for buffer.

4) Private (VPC / On-prem)
- Packaging: v0.9 includes KMS integration and a new install script. CI smoke tests failing on RHEL image (ssh timeout). Work with release-engineering to reproduce and get deterministic failure.
- Customer pilot: ACME Corp install scheduled for 2026-03-18. Must finalize install checklist and run a preflight with infra before the pilot.

Blockers / escalations:
- Proxy pool incident: need decision whether to revert kernel v2.1 on canary to stabilize API latencies while triage continues. Ops favors temporary rollback for canary traffic.
- Dedicated autoscaler change requires finance approval for potential monthly cost increase; flagged for leadership review.
- Private install: release-eng blocked on access to a RHEL runner in CI to repro timeout; needs infra support.

Asks for Maya:
- Decide on rollback appetite for kernel v2.1 on canary vs deeper investigation (stability vs delivery speed).
- Prioritize index/caching work for console dashboards — can SRE allocate ~1 sprint?
- Liaise with Finance on autoscaler cost memo if SRE sign-off is positive.
- Nudge release-eng / infra to provision a RHEL CI runner to unblock packaging tests.

Quick metrics to review in the meeting:
- API: 95th latency (short prompts), 5xx rate (7d), peak QPS.
- Console: dashboard P50/P95 load times, query error rate.
- Dedicated: GPU utilization, queue length during bursts.

Potential decisions:
- Temporary rollback of kernel v2.1 on canary to restore 95p latency while we triage.
- Delay full console rollout until index/caching improvements and copy changes shipped.
- Push Dedicated autoscaler change to staging for a 2-week soak, accompanied by cost memo to Finance.

Follow-up notes / ticket actions:
- Open a postmortem ticket for 2026-03-01 503 spike and assign to infra oncall + eng-runtime.
- Create dedicated autoscaler cost-analysis doc and circulate to Finance + EngOps (owner: Maya).
- Private v0.9: create preflight checklist and schedule preflight run with ACME (owner: Ethan + release-eng).

Tone / personal notes:
- Keep conversation pragmatic — prioritize short-term stabilizers (rollback, stage changes) while defining clear triage owners.
- Surface cross-team blockers early (SRE, release-eng, finance) to avoid hidden delays.
- Confirm Maya has runway for tactical work this sprint; if not, propose reprioritization.
action_items: Decide whether to rollback kernel v2.1 on canary (Maya) - target decision by 2026-03-05
Create API postmortem ticket for 2026-03-01 spike (Ethan + infra) - create by EOD 2026-03-04
Prototype console dashboard query caching and estimate effort (Console eng) - PRD/ETA by 2026-03-10
Draft autoscaler cost impact memo and share with Finance (Maya + EngOps) - due 2026-03-09
Provision RHEL CI runner for Private packaging tests (Release-Engineering/Infra) - unblock request (Maya to nudge), target 2026-03-06
Schedule preflight run with ACME for Private v0.9 and confirm checklist (Ethan + release-eng) - schedule by 2026-03-07
